convar:AlwaysCustomizeOnBadExit.what: Bool (0/1). Probably makes Steam open a customization/recovery prompt after the client exited abnormally. No usage strings found, so this is inferred from the name only.

convar:app_force_preload.what: App ID (0 = off). Forces the given app into preload mode, where content downloads before release. It is read next to the ownership checks (CheckAppOwnership, FreeWeekend, TimedTrialMinutes), so it is mainly a testing override for app ownership and licensing.

convar:app_info_http_min.what: Int, default 0. Probably the minimum number of app/package info requests before the client fetches app info over HTTP instead of the CM connection. It is used by the app-info cache (appdatacache.cpp), next to the handling for 'Server changenumber out of sync'.

convar:app_info_http_num_sockets.what: Int, default 8. Number of HTTP sockets in the 'App Info' HTTP client, which downloads app and package info (PICS) data.

convar:appcloudsessions.what: String, default 'all'. Selects which apps take part in Steam Cloud session tracking ('all' is the only value seen). This is probably a debugging or rollout filter for cloud sync sessions.

convar:@AppMRUSize.what: Int, default 20. Size of the list of most recently played games, which the update manager keeps in RecentLocalPlayedGameIDs (UpdateTimePlayedMRU / UpdateLocallyPlayedMRU). Recently played apps can get update priority.

convar:apps_per_overview_chunk.what: Int, default 5000. Number of apps per chunk when the UI app controller sends app overview data to the library UI. Larger values mean fewer, bigger batches.

convar:AsyncFileIOAlternateReadWrite.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Async file I/O (asyncfileiohandler.cpp): probably alternates between servicing read and write work on the separate read and write I/O threads so neither starves the other.

convar:AsyncFileIODisableWrite.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Debug switch in async file I/O. When set, write commands are skipped or not performed, which is useful to benchmark download and disk throughput without writing to disk. Do not enable it for normal use.

convar:AsyncFileIOExpectOutstandingIO.what: Int, default 6. Expected number of outstanding async I/O operations. It is used to size the async file I/O handle caches and thread queues, and it counts toward the clamp that keeps the read/write handle caches under the process's max open file-descriptor limit.

convar:AsyncFileIOMaxPendingWin32.what: Int, default 256. Maximum pending async I/O requests on the Windows (Win32 overlapped I/O) path. It probably has no effect on Linux.

convar:AsyncFileIOReadHandleCache.what: Int, default 64. Number of open file handles the async file I/O read thread keeps cached. It is clamped automatically so that read and write caches together stay under the max open-descriptor limit.

convar:AsyncFileIOWriteHandleCache.what: Int, default 64. Number of open file handles the async file I/O write thread keeps cached, used during content installs and updates. It is clamped along with the read cache to stay under the open-descriptor limit.

convar:@bAssertOnProtoBufBodyMismatch.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Message-parsing diagnostics. When a protobuf body that was pre-parsed off the main thread has a different type than the handler expects, the client asserts and logs 'Pre-parsed body type disagrees with the handler'. Mismatch counts appear in the 'protobuf_parse_stats' command.

convar:batterycharging.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Probably a debug override that reports the battery as charging, for testing the low-battery handling.

convar:batterypercent.what: Int percent, default -1 (= use the real value). Probably overrides the reported battery percentage for testing; CSteamEngine::CheckForLowBattery uses it to decide whether to raise low-battery notifications.

convar:batterytime.what: Int, default -1 (= use the real value). Probably overrides the reported remaining battery time, which CSteamEngine::CheckForLowBattery uses to trigger low-battery callbacks. Useful for testing low-battery warnings.

convar:bBroadcastAlwaysUploadThumbnails.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Steam Broadcasting: always upload thumbnail images for a broadcast session (set up around Broadcast.BeginBroadcastSession), rather than only when someone is watching.

convar:@bCallerDeadlineAbortJobDisableWh.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Job system and HTTP: once a job's HTTP request has started, the caller's deadline no longer aborts the job, so requests already in flight are not cut off.

convar:bCheckUGCIntegrity.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Workshop/UGC downloads: checks the length and hash of downloaded UGC files and deletes corrupt ones ('[UGC] File corrupted during download'). Failures are reported through Cloud.CDNReport.

convar:bClientConvar601DEACE.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Feature flag with an opaque, hash-like name. The nearby strings are from the IClientUser interface-map serialization ('Fencepost deserialize mismatch'), so it probably toggles some IPC interface behavior. Its exact purpose is unknown.

convar:@bClientDownloadUseHTTPS.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Content downloads use HTTPS on content servers that support it, instead of plain HTTP. Can be overridden server-side.

convar:@bClientOpenCacheStickyRedirects.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Content downloads through a caching proxy (for example a LAN cache): when the proxy redirects the client, the client remembers the redirect ('memorizing that'). If the redirect points at the origin server itself, the client forgets the proxy.

convar:bClientPingCSesForCellID.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Probably makes the client ping content servers to choose its download region (cell ID) instead of using the server-assigned one.

convar:@bClientTryRequestManifestWithout.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Content downloads: tries to fetch a depot manifest even when it has no manifest request code (normally obtained from the backend first). Useful for diagnostics.

convar:bCloudAcceptUnexpectedAutoCloudFi.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Steam Cloud (Auto-Cloud) cache validation: when a file on disk has a different SHA or timestamp than the cached record, or has gone missing, the client accepts that as a local change and syncs it, rather than treating it as an error.

convar:@bCloudSyncFailDownloadIfGameOutO.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Cloud: makes the cloud download sync fail when the game itself needs an update, so old game builds don't load newer saves.

convar:@bCSForceNoCache.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Content-server downloads: sends 'Cache-Control' no-cache and appends a cache-busting query string ('?%u') to chunk requests, so CDN and proxy caches are bypassed.

convar:bDelayGameUpdatesOnBeta.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Auto-update scheduling: when on, clients on the Steam Beta also get scheduled (delayed) game updates. When off, beta clients update games as soon as possible.

convar:@bDepotBuilderReadBufferSizeKB.what: Int KB, default 8192 (8 MB). Despite the 'b' prefix this is a size: the read buffer that the depot builder's file reader thread uses when chunking files for content builds and uploads (chunkfinder.cpp).

convar:@bDepotBuilderUnbufferedReads.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Depot builder / content chunking: reads source files unbuffered (bypassing the OS cache, e.g. O_DIRECT), which needs the chunk size to align with the disk sector size ('Default chunk and disk sector size don't align').

convar:bDepotDeltaPatchUseAPI.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Content updates: applies downloaded depot delta patches (depot_<id>_<from>_<to>.delta in DepotDeltaPatches) with the patching API, instead of the older method.

convar:bDepotUseSparseFiles.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Content updates: creates installed and staged files as sparse files, so they don't take up their full size on disk until written.

convar:@bDisableDualStackDownloads.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Content downloads: forces an IPv4-only HTTP client for depot downloads instead of the default dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 client. Try it if IPv6 downloads are broken.

convar:bDisableTenFootOverlay.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Disables the Big Picture (ten-foot) version of the in-game overlay. No usage strings.

convar:@bDownloadThrottleDuringCloudSync.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Applies the download bandwidth limit (DownloadThrottleKbps) while Steam Cloud syncs run, too.

convar:@bEnableFrameFuncOverageWarnings.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Logs a warning when a frame function goes over its time budget (CFrameFunctionMgr 'OverageWarning'). Output goes to SPEW_MISC at level 4, so you also need to raise spew levels to see it.

convar:@bEnableHTTP2OnAllCHTTPClients.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Turns on HTTP/2 automatically for every internal CHTTPClient pool on SSL connections.

convar:bEnableLoginUsersErrorUpload.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Login UI: uploads log files when the client fails to load login user info (loginusers), to help diagnose problems.

convar:@bEnableLogTearOff.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Logging subsystem (logger.cpp, present in all binaries): probably lets the logger hand writes off from the main thread, or 'tear off' log output to a separate stream.

convar:bEnableMHRCAsyncFileReadLog.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Turns on logging of async file reads in some 'MHRC' component; what that component is is unknown.

convar:@bEnableNetworkJobsOwnStartList.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Job manager: network-started jobs get their own start/yield list (CJobMgr JobYielding_t linked list), separate from other jobs. This is an internal scheduling tweak.

convar:@bEnableOfflineLogonTicket.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Login: asks the server for an offline logon ticket during login if none is cached, so Offline Mode works later.

convar:@bEnableSiteLicenseConnect.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Lets the client connect to a site-license (cafe/LAN center) server when one is present.

convar:@bEnableSiteLicenseConsoleLogging.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Site-license provider (steamcmd -sitelicense): writes verbose site-license logs to the console, including authentication and local content cache status.

convar:@bEnableSpewThrottle.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Logging: rate-limits repeated debug spew and log messages in all Steam binaries.

convar:bEnableSubscribedFileListCache.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Workshop: caches the user's subscribed-file list (from PublishedFile.GetUserFiles) so it isn't fetched again every time.

convar:@bEnforceValidEmailDomains.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. When validating an email address (BIsValidEmailAddress), the domain must be valid too.

convar:betaalwaysrebuild.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Game launch flow (gameactionlaunchapp.cpp): probably forces a rebuild/re-verify step on every launch for beta branches. The evidence is weak.

convar:bExternalProcessForVOD.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Video playback (steam://video/watch/<appid>): plays the video in a separate external process instead of inside the client.

convar:bFinishStagedDepotVersions.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Content updates: if an earlier update was interrupted, finishes downloading the staged manifest version first ('resuming download of previous manifest') instead of switching to the newest one.

convar:@bForceAbsoluteMouseCoordinates.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Forces absolute mouse coordinates (the per-app extended/AbsoluteMouseCoordinates setting) for every app. Probably affects Remote Play and Steam Input mouse injection.

convar:@bForceLaunchEula.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Shows an app's launch EULA every time, ignoring the 'ViewedLaunchEULA' flag stored in the app's registry/config.

convar:@bForceOverlayAudioRecorder.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Game recording/broadcast: forces the overlay-based audio capture path and disables the Media Foundation path, which only exists on Windows.

convar:@bForceStreamUnsupportedApp.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Remote Play: allows streaming an app even if it is marked as unsupported (extended/DisableStreaming).

convar:@bHttpClientRecordHostnameDimensi.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. HTTP metrics: adds the hostname as a dimension, alongside method, status and response latency. This can create many distinct metric keys and use a lot of memory.

convar:@bHTTPServerHTTP2Enabled.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Built-in HTTPS server (uses a self-signed certificate): the global default for advertising HTTP/2 over TLS via ALPN. A server that calls SetHTTP2Enabled() explicitly ignores it.

convar:bInstallscriptReports.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Sends reports to Valve when an app's install script (installscript.vdf) fails.

convar:@bLANPeerConnectionTimeoutSec.what: Int seconds, default 5. Despite the 'b' prefix this is a timeout: how long to wait when connecting to a LAN peer for peer-to-peer content transfer (ContentServerDirectory.RequestPeerContentServer) before 'Timed out connecting'.

convar:@bLogMessageToProtobufClass.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Message diagnostics: the first time the client sees a message type (EMsg), it logs which protobuf class that message uses ('MessageToProtobufClass: ...').

convar:@bMeasureSSLLatencyStats.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Collects latency statistics for SSL/TLS connections (handshake and round trip) for networking metrics.

convar:@bMetricsEnabled.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Master switch for job metrics collected and reported through IMetricsReporters. Individual operations can still be turned off or on by a blacklist or whitelist.

convar:@bMsgErrorDump.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. When a network message fails to parse, dumps it in hex (header, struct and var data) to the log for debugging.

convar:bPrefetchDownloadDetails.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Content updates: works out the download size of a pending update ahead of time, so the size is known before the update runs.

convar:@bProfileYieldsInTestSuiteJobs.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Profiles job yields when running internal test-suite jobs. Developer-only.

convar:@bProtoBufNetPacketDropRawBytes.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. CM message handling: frees an inbound packet's raw bytes once its header and body have been pre-parsed (the SSL thread also avoids copying them), and rebuilds them only if a caller asks. This saves memory; see 'protobuf_parse_stats'.

convar:@bProtobufParseSizeProfile.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Keeps a histogram of protobuf message body sizes as they are parsed, shown by the 'protobuf_parse_stats' console command.

convar:@bProtobufParseTimeProfile.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Also times each protobuf body parse, so 'protobuf_parse_stats' can show ms/us per size bucket and how much parsing moved off the job thread. It adds two clock reads per parse.

convar:@bRefreshDownloadSourcesFrequentl.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Content downloads: refreshes the list of download sources (content servers, caches, peers) more often, while connection counts are adjusted based on the current download rate (Mbps).

convar:@bRequireOfflineLogonTicket.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Login: you need a valid cached offline logon ticket to log in in Offline Mode or with no connection.

convar:broadcast_adjust_bitrate.what: Int, default 200. Steam Broadcasting: probably the step (likely kbps) by which the encoder bitrate is raised or lowered when upload conditions change.

convar:broadcast_upload_drop_sec.what: Int seconds, default 6. Steam Broadcasting upload: when the upload queue falls this many seconds behind, video frames are dropped ('Upload job : dropped %u video frames').

convar:broadcast_upload_update_sec.what: Int seconds, default 3. Steam Broadcasting: how often the BroadcastUploadStatus_t callback is posted (bytes sent, dropped and pending, processing time).

convar:@bScreenshotsLegacyCloudUpload.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Screenshots: uploads screenshots through the legacy Steam Cloud upload path instead of the current one.

convar:bShaderAllowReplay.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Shader cache manager (Linux/Vulkan): allows replaying Fossilize pipeline caches in the background to precompile shaders for an app.

convar:bShaderAllowReplayOnNVIDIA.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Shader cache manager: allows background Fossilize replay on NVIDIA GPUs. If 0, the client logs 'Replay currently disabled on NVIDIA'.

convar:bShaderAlwaysProcessWhenRunningGa.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Shader cache manager: keeps doing background shader processing (Fossilize replay) while a game is running, instead of pausing it.

convar:bShaderCacheDownloads.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Shader pre-caching: allows downloading pre-compiled shader cache depots (type 'shadercachedepot').

convar:@bShaderClientGetBucketManifestUs.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Shader pre-caching: fetches shader bucket manifests through the web API (IShaderService/GetBucketManifestUsingKeyHash) instead of over the CM connection.

convar:bShaderDepotNative.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Shader pre-caching: converts downloaded shader depots into the native driver cache format (e.g. VulkanPipelinesV<n>, steam_shader_cache folders), rather than using them only through Fossilize/swarm archives.

convar:bShaderEnableCacheManagement.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Master switch for the shader cache manager (shader pre-caching, background processing, cache folders). It can also be turned off by the STEAM_ENABLE_SHADER_CACHE_MANAGEMENT environment variable, the command line or the registry; it is always off under steamcmd.

convar:bShaderEnableFossilizeLayer.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Shader pre-caching: injects the Vulkan Fossilize layer (ENABLE_VK_LAYER_VALVE_steam_fossilize_1, STEAM_FOSSILIZE_DUMP_PATH) into games to record pipelines into .foz caches.

convar:bShaderEnableUpload.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Shader pre-caching: uploads the client's recorded shaders and pipelines to Valve when the server asks for them ('Server requested %u shaders; uploading is enabled/disabled').

convar:bShaderFossilizeFastMerge.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Shader cache: uses a fast merge when combining Fossilize (.foz) pipeline cache files (steam_pipeline_cache, replay_cache, video/audio media caches) into one archive.

convar:bShaderPrecompiledCache.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Shader pre-caching: uses precompiled shader buckets from Valve and points Mesa at them as read-only Fossilize databases (MESA_DISK_CACHE_READ_ONLY_FOZ_DBS=steam_precompiled_*).

convar:bShaderVerboseLogs.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Shader cache manager: writes detailed logs about bucket and depot manifest requests, compat-tool buckets and precompiled cache lookups.

convar:@bShowUninstalledDemosInLibrary.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Library: shows demos that are not installed in the games list (IsVisibleInGamesList).

convar:bSingleFileUpdateMode.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Content updates: when free disk space is too low for normal staging, updates one file at a time ('switching to single file update mode (%u MB needed, %u MB available)').

convar:@bSiteLicenseAllowCachedClientCre.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Site license (cafe/LAN center): lets clients associated with the site save their username and login credentials on the machine.

convar:@bSiteLicenseProxyCacheIsExternal.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Site-license provider: the local content caching proxy runs in a separate external process instead of inside steamcmd ('Local content cache ENABLED for an EXTERNAL process at ip:port'). Usually you also set @sSiteLicenseProxyExplicitIP.

convar:@bSiteLicenseProxyEnableIPv6.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Site-license (SLS) proxy: allows IPv6 connections to the Steam servers.

convar:@bSiteLicenseServer.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Makes this instance run as a site-license provider, the same as the '-sitelicense' command-line flag ('Enabling use as site license provider via convar').

convar:@bSSLThreadedMsgParse.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. CM connection: parses Steam3 message headers and bodies on the SSL work thread, not only framing them there, to take work off the main thread. Takes effect immediately.

convar:@bSSLThreadedMsgParseRelayedBodie.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. CM connection: also pre-parses the bodies of service methods that run on the client. Off by default because the servers that relay them (CM and UDS) never look at the body; check 'protobuf_parse_stats'.

convar:@bSSLThreadedSendDelivery.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. TCP/SSL connections: delivers outgoing messages from the SSL work thread instead of the calling thread.

convar:bSteam3LimitedUserEnable.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Probably turns on handling for limited user accounts (accounts that have not spent money and have restricted features).

convar:bSteamLoaderEnable.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Turns on the 'Steam loader' feature, probably the game launch/loader stub. The evidence is thin.

convar:bUseSystemBrowserFor2DVOD.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Video playback: opens normal (2D) videos (steam://video/watch/<appid>) in the system web browser (steam://openurl_external) instead of inside Steam.

convar:bVerifyAllDownloads.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Content updates: verifies every file after an update has downloaded (the VerifyUpdates behavior), not just the changed ones.

convar:bVerifyAllInstalled.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Content updates: verifies all installed files before applying an update.

convar:cAppUpdateWorkingSetMB.what: Int MB, default 256. Content updates: probably the memory working-set budget used while downloading, decrypting and writing update chunks.

convar:@cbPartnerUploadChunkSize.what: Int bytes, default 1000000. Partner uploads: chunk size for POSTing content to partner.steamgames.com in pieces using Content-Range.

convar:cChunkValidationMaxLog.what: Int, default 100. Content validation: maximum number of bad-chunk messages to log during one validation, to keep logs from flooding.

convar:@cCSClientMaxNumSocketsPerHost.what: Int, default 4. Content downloads: maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections to each content server host in the 'Depot Download' HTTP client.

convar:@cCSClientMaxNumSocketsPerHostFor.what: Int, default 32. Content downloads: maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections to a caching proxy or LAN cache host. It is higher than for normal content servers.

convar:@cDefaultInitialDownloadSources.what: Int, default 4. Content downloads: number of download sources (content servers, caches, peers) to connect to at the start of a download, before adjusting based on throughput.

convar:@cDepotBuilderFileChunkingThreads.what: Int, default 0 (= automatic). Depot builder: number of threads used to chunk files during content builds.

convar:@cFileChunkingCRCFalseAlarmBytesT.what: Int bytes, default 128. Depot builder chunk finder: when a rolling-CRC chunk match turns out to be wrong after the SHA check, skips this many bytes before trying again.

convar:@cFileChunkingCRCFalseAlarmThresh.what: Int, default 0. Depot builder chunk finder: number of false CRC matches allowed before skipping ahead (see @cFileChunkingCRCFalseAlarmBytesToSkip). 0 probably turns the heuristic off.

convar:@cFileChunkingSupersectionSizeMB.what: Int MB, default 1024. Depot builder: size of the file 'supersections' that the file-section chunker threads work on in parallel.

convar:cFileValidationMaxLog.what: Int, default 100. Content validation: maximum number of bad-file messages to log during one verify.

convar:ClickPanel.what: String, default 'index'. Valve's help text is just 'code', and 'code' and 'index' are the only values seen. This is a VGUI debug option that controls what is shown or logged when you click a panel (probably its code location or index). Developer-only.

convar:ClientConnectTokenBucketEnable.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. CM connection: rate-limits reconnect attempts to Steam servers with a token bucket. When throttled, the client posts SteamServersConnectionAttemptThottled_t with a cooldown expiry time.

convar:clientui_overlay_fps.what: Int FPS, default 60. Probably the frame rate cap for the client UI when it is drawn as the in-game overlay.

convar:clientuistats_batchsize.what: Int, default 0. Client UI usage stats (ClientUIComponentDisplay events): number of events to queue before writing a batch. 0 writes each row immediately.

convar:@cloud_testdynamicsyncapp.what: App ID, default 0. Steam Cloud testing: treats the given app as using dynamic sync, including 'sync_while_suspended'. Developer-only.

convar:@cMaxContentServersToRequest.what: Int, default 20. Content downloads: maximum number of content servers to ask the directory for when building the download server list.

convar:cMaxDecryptThreadsOverride.what: Int, default 0 (= automatic). Content updates: overrides the number of CPU threads that decrypt and decompress chunks (CContentUpdateContext CPU thread pool).

convar:@cMaxInitialDownloadSources.what: Int, default -1 (no limit). Content downloads (CDepotDownloadMgr): caps how many download sources the client starts with, across source priority classes. Sources are still filtered by app, and some are skipped as Steam China-only.

convar:@cMinimumJobTimeoutsToCheckPerFra.what: Int, default 100. Job manager: the minimum number of jobs whose timeouts are checked each frame in CJobMgr::BCheckForJobTimeouts.

convar:@cNetEncryptionHandshakeWorkMax_H.what: Int, default 8000. Networking: the work budget (probably handshakes per period) for high-priority encrypted connection handshakes. The low- and medium-priority versions have budgets of 2000 and 4000.

convar:@cNetEncryptionHandshakeWorkMax_L.what: Int, default 2000. Networking: the work budget for low-priority encrypted connection handshakes; see the HighPri/MedPri versions.

convar:@cNetEncryptionHandshakeWorkMax_M.what: Int, default 4000. Networking: the work budget for medium-priority encrypted connection handshakes; see the HighPri/LowPri versions.

convar:com.steampowered.Atomupd1.what: Probably not a real setting. It looks like a D-Bus object path ('/com/steampowered/Atomupd1') caught by the extractor, with the method names DisableHttpProxy/EnableHttpProxy as 'help'. It is used to pass the client's HTTP proxy settings to the SteamOS atomic updater (atomupd) over D-Bus.

convar:controller_base_rotation_angle.what: Number, default 0. Steam Input: probably a base rotation angle applied to controller stick or trackpad input. Its usage is near the 'Ignoring initial input' connection handling.

convar:controller_debug_triton_wireless.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input debugging for the 'Triton' controller (Valve's internal codename, believed to be the new Steam Controller) over a wireless connection. Probably adds wireless/serial-number debug handling in controller.cpp.

convar:controller_edge_cutoff.what: Number, default 0. Steam Input: probably an edge cutoff or deadzone at the outer edge of a trackpad or stick. Its exact units are unknown.

convar:controller_gyro_x_scale.what: Int, default 16000. Steam Input: the scale factor used to convert gyro X-axis input into 2D (mouse or stick) output.

convar:controller_idle_poll_interval.what: Int microseconds, default 50000 (20 Hz). Steam Input: how often idle controllers are polled.

convar:controller_jerk_low_pass_filter_r.what: Float, default 4. Steam Input (Steam Deck): how quickly the low-pass filter follows the raw gyro 'jerk' value used for jerk/shake detection.

convar:controller_jerk_threshold.what: Float, default 500. Steam Input: the gyro jerk (change in gyro per second) needed to count one 'controller jerk' event. Steam Deck only (Neptune/Galileo).

convar:controller_jerk_threshold_debug.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input: logs the gyro noise, raw jerk value, low-pass jerk value, threshold and jerk count, for tuning controller_jerk_threshold.

convar:controller_jerk_throttle.what: Float Hz, default 2. Steam Input: the maximum rate at which controller jerk event callbacks are sent.

convar:controller_min_activation_time.what: Float seconds, default 0.0333 (about one frame at 30 Hz). Steam Input: probably the minimum time an action stays active once triggered, so very short presses still register.

convar:controller_momentum_min_vel.what: Float, default 0. Steam Input trackpad momentum (trackball mode): probably the minimum swipe speed needed to start momentum.

convar:controller_momentum_num_excluded_.what: Int, default 1. Steam Input trackpad momentum: the number of most recent touch samples left out when estimating release speed (trackpad_weightedfilter).

convar:controller_momentum_num_included_.what: Int, default 5. Steam Input trackpad momentum: the number of touch samples averaged by the weighted filter to estimate release speed.

convar:controller_poll_state.what: Int, default -1 (automatic). Steam Input: forces the controller polling state used by the HID I/O thread ('Controller PollState Changed from %d to %d'). This is a debugging override.

convar:controller_rate.what: Int microseconds, default 2000 (500 Hz). Steam Input: how often active controllers are polled. It is probably linked to the SteamController_Poll_Rate setting.

convar:controller_simulate_trackpad.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input debug: when the left trackpad is touched, simulates a swipe on the right trackpad.

convar:controller_spew_level.what: Int log level, default 3. Steam Input: how verbose controller logging is (config load/save, SDL mappings, controller info reads). Higher means more output.

convar:countrycode.what: String, no default. CM login (cminterface.cpp): probably overrides the country code the client reports for the account or IP at logon. Mainly for testing.

convar:cPreallocateMinimumSizeKB.what: Int KB, default 256. Content installs: only files at least this large have their disk space allocated up front (AllocateDiskSpace).

convar:@csecAudioSignalLevelInterval.what: Float seconds, default 60. Game recording audio capture: how often the signal levels (dB) of each audio source are written to the log.

convar:@csecCSJobSuccessfulRequestTimeWi.what: Int seconds, default 60. Content downloads: the time window used to judge whether a content-server connection has made successful requests recently, which decides things like turning off dual-stack for that connection.

convar:@csecCSRequestProcessorTimeOut.what: Int seconds, default 300. Content downloads: a content-server request processor that is idle or making no progress for this long closes its connection ('Timed out waiting for progress after %d seconds').

convar:@csecDurationControlPeriod.what: Int seconds. Duration control (China anti-indulgence playtime limits): overrides the first playtime threshold for testing. Nonzero sets the threshold to this many seconds; 0 uses the normal one.

convar:@csecDurationControlPeriodToday.what: Int seconds. Duration control: overrides the per-day playtime threshold for testing. Nonzero sets the limit to this many seconds.

convar:@csecDurationControlSimulated.what: Int seconds. Duration control testing: pretends the user has already played this many seconds recently. Setting it makes the client ask the backend (Player.GetDurationControl) with the overridden state.

convar:@csecDurationControlSimulatedNonR.what: Int seconds. Duration control testing: pretends the user has already played this many seconds today, but not recently.

convar:@csecFavoriteGameAccountCacheTime.what: Int seconds, default 86400 (1 day). Server browser: how often the game-server account IDs in the favorites list are refreshed (GameServers.GetServerSteamIDsByIP / GetServerIPsBySteamID).

convar:@csecIncomingDataRatePeriod.what: Int seconds, default 1. Content downloads: the sampling period for measuring the incoming download rate (Mbps), which decides whether to add more download connections.

convar:csecManifestDownloadTimeout.what: Int seconds, default 120. Content updates: timeout for downloading a depot manifest before it counts as failed ('failed to downloading manifest').

convar:@csecSiteLicenseProxyStatsLog.what: Int seconds, default 60. Site-license content proxy: how often connection, request, byte and cached-byte statistics are written to the log.

convar:@csecSiteLicenseProxyStatsUpdate.what: Int seconds, default 1. Site-license content proxy: how often the internal statistics are updated.

convar:@csecUpdateTargetNumConnectionsEp.what: Int seconds, default 10. Content downloads: how often the client reconsiders the target number of download connections based on the measured rate.

convar:@cSecUploadDownloadRates.what: Int seconds, default 300. Content downloads: how often recorded download-rate statistics per source are reported to Steam (CJobUploadDownloadRates; also saved as RecentDownloadRate).

convar:@CSInterfaceProxyPassword.what: String. Content downloads: the password for an HTTP proxy used to reach content servers, sent with Basic auth as 'user:pass'. Use it together with @CSInterfaceProxyUsername.

convar:@CSInterfaceProxyUsername.what: String. Content downloads: the username for an HTTP proxy used to reach content servers (Basic auth). Use it together with @CSInterfaceProxyPassword.

convar:@cUDPSendRetries.what: Int, default 8. Legacy UDP connection layer (udpconnection.cpp): how many times an unacknowledged packet is resent before giving up.

convar:CursorMoved.what: Probably not a real setting: a VGUI/HTML panel message name ('CursorMoved' with xpos/ypos) caught by the extractor. It carries cursor-position events for HTML panels, and there is nothing to set.

convar:@CustomBinaryRequestRetryTimes.what: Int, default 20. DRM: how many times to retry a custom DRM binary request (RequestCustomBinary / CClientDRMDownloadJob).

convar:debugLaunchAppDelaySecs.what: Int seconds, default 0. Game launch debugging: adds an artificial delay to the launch steps (license check, cloud sync, Steam Input config sync), for testing the launch progress UI.

convar:deck_mouse_haptic_tick_dist.what: Int, default 9000. Steam Deck trackpad-as-mouse: the distance moved (in raw trackpad units) between haptic 'ticks'.

convar:deck_mouse_leftside_filter.what: Int, default 30500. Steam Deck: probably a raw-coordinate threshold that filters touches on the left side or edge of a trackpad when it is used as a mouse.

convar:@DepotBuilderDeltaMaxChunks.what: Int, default 20000. Depot builder: the maximum number of chunks to consider when building delta patches between builds.

convar:@DepotBuilderEnableVZd.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Depot builder: allows chunks to be compressed with Valve's 'VZd' format (probably the Zstd-based variant).

convar:@DepotBuilderMaxParallelUploadChu.what: Int, default 24. Depot builder: the maximum number of chunks uploaded or written at once, including writing depots to a local content server (LCS).

convar:@DepotBuilderNumHTTPSocketsToMDS.what: Int, default 12. Depot builder: number of HTTP sockets in the 'Depot Build' client that talks to the manifest/depot upload server (MDS).

convar:@DepotBuilderParallelUploadChunks.what: Int, default 6. Depot builder: number of chunks uploaded or verified in parallel (chunk verify worker pool).

convar:@DepotBuilderProgressTimeout.what: Int, default 1000 (probably seconds). Depot builder: if a build makes no upload progress for this long, it fails ('No progress while uploading chunks', 'Timeout uploading manifest').

convar:@DepotBuilderVZdMinRatio.what: Float, default 0.4. Depot builder: the VZd-compressed size must be at most this fraction of the original before VZd is used. Otherwise another compression is used.

convar:@DepotBuilderXORMatchPercent.what: Int percent, default 95. Depot builder delta/patch generation: the similarity a chunk needs to an older chunk before it is stored as an XOR delta.

convar:DepotDeltaPatches.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Content updates: allows downloading and applying depot delta patches (depot_<id>_<from>_<to>.delta) instead of whole changed chunks.

convar:DepotDownloadProgressTimeout.what: Int seconds, default 120. Content updates: how long depot reconstruction waits for download progress before it treats the update as stalled.

convar:DepotMinWriteGapSizeMB.what: Int MB, default 64. Content updates (depotreconstruct): the minimum gap between write regions when grouping chunk writes. It relates to the extra downloads in single-file mode.

convar:DepotReconstructionBadChunk.what: Int, default 0. Content updates debug: probably deliberately corrupts or marks a chunk as bad, to test bad-chunk handling.

convar:DepotReconstructionForceGenericIO.what: Content updates (depot reconstruction): forces the generic file I/O path instead of the optimized/async one. 'all' was seen as a possible value, perhaps a per-depot selector.

convar:DepotReconstructionLowPrio.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Content updates: runs depot reconstruction (decrypt, decompress, write) at low thread/IO priority so it doesn't slow down the system.

convar:DepotReconstructionNumIOThreads.what: Int, default 32. Content updates: number of disk I/O threads used during depot reconstruction.

convar:DepotUseAlternatingReadWrite.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Content updates: when using chunks from a staged chunk store, alternates between read and write phases instead of doing both at once.

convar:developer.what: Int, default 0. General developer mode for the client UI. When set, extra developer commands and features are available, such as profiling commands, the devtools file links and debug menu tasks.

convar:@durationControlNightCheck.what: Int enum, default 1. Duration control (China anti-indulgence): the time-of-day check. 1 = normal, 2 = force night-time, 0 = no check (only allowed for age-verified accounts).

convar:@EnableUDPHistory.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Keeps a history of UDP connection packets or events for debugging the legacy UDP transport.

convar:@fDownloadRateImprovementToAddAno.what: Float ratio, default 1.2. Content downloads: adding a connection must raise the download rate by at least this factor (20%) before the client keeps adding more.

convar:@fMinDataRateToAttemptTwoConnecti.what: Float Mbps, default 1.5. Content downloads: the minimum measured download rate before the client tries a second download connection.

convar:force_software_gyro_drift_correct.what: Int, default 0. Steam Input gyro: 0 = use software drift calibration only when the controller needs it, 1 = force the standard software drift calibration on every controller with an IMU.

convar:@ForceContentServer.what: String hostname or IP (empty = off). Content downloads: always use this content server instead of the list from ContentServerDirectory.GetServersForSteamPipe ('Forcing content server %s for download!'). Useful for testing a particular CDN node or a LAN cache.

convar:@ForceContentServerHTTPS.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Content downloads: connect to the server set in @ForceContentServer over HTTPS.

convar:@ForceContentServerType.what: String. Content downloads: only use content servers of this type (e.g. CDN, SteamCache, OpenCache), probably with 'local' as a special value. It filters the server list from ContentServerDirectory.

convar:g_RumbleRepeatAfterDelaySeconds.what: Float seconds, default 0.050. Steam Input rumble: the delay before a rumble command is sent again to keep it going.

convar:g_RumbleSustainTimeSeconds.what: Float seconds, default 10. Steam Input rumble: the longest a rumble effect is kept going without new commands before it stops.

convar:@GCNameOverride.what: String. Game Coordinator (ISteamGameCoordinator): overrides which Game Coordinator name or instance messages are sent to. Developer testing.

convar:grip_sense_haptic_test.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input debug: plays a test haptic pulse when grip sense (capacitive grip) is triggered.

convar:grip_sense_haptic_test_repeats.what: Int, default 1. Number of pulses for the grip-sense haptic test (see grip_sense_haptic_test).

convar:grip_sense_haptic_test_strength.what: Int, default 125. Strength of the grip-sense haptic test pulse (see grip_sense_haptic_test).

convar:gyro_auto_detect_polling_rate.what: Int enum, default 1 (wired controllers only). Steam Input gyro: how the IMU polling rate is worked out. 0 = legacy (buggy with controllers at 1000 Hz or more), 1 = use SDL3 sensor timing but fall back to estimating from the packet rate when it looks wrong, 2 = always estimate from the packet rate.

convar:gyro_calibration_duration_automat.what: Float seconds, default 5.0. Steam Input gyro: how long a controller must stay still to calibrate drift automatically. Shorter times are more likely to produce wrong corrections.

convar:gyro_calibration_duration_manual.what: Float seconds, default 5.0. Steam Input gyro: how long manual drift calibration runs. Longer is more accurate.

convar:gyro_calibration_duration_manual_.what: Float seconds, default 30. Steam Input gyro: if manual drift calibration hasn't succeeded within this time, it goes back to calibrating noise tolerance.

convar:gyro_calibration_duration_station.what: Float seconds, default 5.0. Steam Input gyro: how long to sample while still to measure gyro and accelerometer noise tolerance.

convar:gyro_debug_gyro_speed_vs_quaterni.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input gyro debug: logs the raw gyro speed next to the rotation speed taken from the quaternion, per hardware frame.

convar:gyro_debug_hardware_vs_mode_time.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input gyro debug: logs the hardware delta time next to the platform/mode delta time and prediction timing.

convar:gyro_debug_sensor_timings.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input gyro debug: logs IMU sensor timing, including expected and measured delta-µs, rate changes and fallbacks to estimated polling rates.

convar:gyro_drift_calibration_debug.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input gyro debug: shows which sensor (accelerometer or gyro) is restarting drift calibration because of noise, and logs candidate and applied drift values. Drift values are saved per controller in <serial>_gyro.vdf.

convar:gyro_drift_correction_enabled.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Steam Input: turns software gyro drift correction on or off.

convar:gyro_drift_detection_debug.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input gyro debug: logs how far the gyro has turned over time ('Detected Gyro Deflection').

convar:gyro_drift_detection_duration.what: Float seconds, default 30. Steam Input gyro: how long the client samples before raising a 'gyro needs calibration' warning.

convar:gyro_drift_detection_min_deflecti.what: Float degrees, default 270. Steam Input gyro: how many degrees the gyro must turn before it counts as drift. This is deliberately more than normal use would produce.

convar:gyro_drift_detection_min_drift_ra.what: Float degrees/second, default 0.1. Steam Input gyro: the lowest steady rotation rate that counts as noticeable drift.

convar:gyro_filter_enabled.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Steam Input gyro: applies a pseudo One-Euro smoothing filter to the gyro rotation (quaternion) to reduce sensor noise and hand shake.

convar:gyro_filter_max_speed.what: Float degrees/second, default 16. Steam Input gyro filter: above this rotation speed, no smoothing is applied.

convar:gyro_filter_min_speed.what: Float degrees/second, default 2. Steam Input gyro filter: below this rotation speed, maximum smoothing (low-pass) is applied.

convar:gyro_filter_smoothness.what: Int 1-100, default 75. Steam Input gyro filter: how strong the low-pass smoothing is. 1 is heavily smoothed (barely responds), 100 is barely smoothed.

convar:gyro_force_handheld_orientation.what: Int enum, default 0. Steam Input gyro orientation: 0 = auto, 1 = handheld like the Steam Deck (pitched 90°, yaw goes through the screen), 2 = standalone controller like the Steam Controller (yaw goes through the sticks).

convar:gyro_force_sensor_rate.what: Int Hz, default 0. Steam Input gyro: 0 = use the IMU's timing and drop suspicious samples; nonzero = ignore sensor timing and assume this fixed rate (e.g. 250 for PS4/PS5, 200 for Switch).

convar:gyro_handheld_pitch_offset.what: Float degrees, default 90. Steam Input gyro: in handheld mode, how far the gyro rotation is tilted before processing. This only affects the Yaw/Roll/Laser-pointer styles of Gyro to Mouse and Gyro to Joystick Camera.

convar:gyro_haptic_probe_enabled.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input: turns on the experimental 'haptic probe' gyro mode, which gives haptic feedback as the gyro moves. The config's haptic level must not be 'off'.

convar:gyro_haptic_probe_max_pulse.what: Int, default 100. Steam Input haptic probe: pulse strength at the highest gyro speed.

convar:gyro_haptic_probe_max_speed.what: Float degrees/second, default 360. Steam Input haptic probe: the gyro speed at which the strongest pulse is used.

convar:gyro_haptic_probe_min_pulse.what: Int, default 20. Steam Input haptic probe: pulse strength at the lowest gyro speed. Valve's help text was copied from max_pulse, but the name and default show this is the minimum.

convar:gyro_haptic_probe_min_speed.what: Float degrees/second, default 0.125. Steam Input haptic probe: the lowest gyro speed that produces haptic feedback.

convar:gyro_haptic_probe_offset_scale.what: Float degrees, default 0.65. Steam Input haptic probe: how far apart the set of probes is spread (0 = all in one place, 1 = 1° apart).

convar:gyro_haptic_probe_types.what: Int enum, default 3. Steam Input haptic probe output: 0 = none, 1 = trackpad haptics only, 2 = rumble only, 3 = both.

convar:gyro_precision_speed.what: Float, default 0.75. Steam Input gyro: the multiplier or threshold for the precision-speed response; see gyro_precision_speed_enabled.

convar:gyro_precision_speed_enabled.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Steam Input gyro: applies a linear response multiplier to speeds below the precision speed set in 'Gyro To...' modes, after the speed deadzone, for finer slow aiming.

convar:gyro_prediction_correction_speed_.what: Float degrees/second, default 180. Steam Input gyro prediction: above this speed, the predicted rotation is fully corrected toward the measured value. The correction is still gradual.
Float degrees/second, default 30. Steam Input gyro prediction: below this speed, the predicted rotation is not corrected toward the measured value.

convar:gyro_prediction_enabled.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Steam Input gyro: predicts rotation from the last known gyro speed. This smooths uneven Bluetooth delivery and gyros slower than 500 Hz.

convar:gyro_raw_deadzone.what: Float, default 6.0. Steam Input: the legacy deadzone on the raw gyro signal. Only affects 'As Mouse' and modes based on it.

convar:gyro_sensor_margin_of_error_pct.what: Int percent, default 25. Steam Input gyro: how far (+/-) sensor timing may differ from the expected value before the client falls back to estimating the polling rate from packets. Valve's help says it applies when gyro_auto_detect_polling_rate is 2, though mode 1's description suggests it is used there too.

convar:gyro_speed_deadzone.what: Float, default 0.5 (probably degrees/second). Steam Input gyro: the minimum rotation speed before the gyro response updates; see gyro_speed_deadzone_enabled.

convar:gyro_speed_deadzone_enabled.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Steam Input gyro: turns on the minimum-speed deadzone (gyro_speed_deadzone).

convar:gyro_stationary_calibration_debug.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input gyro debug: shows which sensor (gyro or accelerometer) is restarting noise-tolerance calibration because its noise is too high, and logs the resulting tolerances.

convar:gyro_to_joystick_camera_raw.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Steam Input: A/B test switch between two Gyro to Joystick Camera pipelines (1 vs 0). Valve's help calls both 'old', so it is unclear which is newer.

convar:gyro_to_joystick_camera_relax.what: Float, default 0. Steam Input Gyro to Joystick Camera: an experimental low-pass filter on the output, meant to help games with low frame rates. Valve marks it 'needs more thought'.

convar:gyro_use_polling_time_for_predict.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. Steam Input gyro prediction: uses the main loop's cached time instead of reading the clock again. Only for A/B testing.

convar:haptic_click_gain_modifier.what: Number, default 0. Steam Input haptics: a gain adjustment applied to trackpad 'click' haptic pulses.

convar:haptic_intensity.what: Int, default 8000. Steam Input haptics: the base intensity (amplitude) of trackpad haptic pulses in the newer haptic code. Compare haptic_intensity_old (2500).

convar:haptic_intensity_old.what: Int, default 2500. Steam Input haptics: the base pulse intensity used by the legacy haptic code (when haptic_new = 0).

convar:haptic_new.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Steam Input: switches to the newer controller haptics code. Testing toggle.

convar:haptic_off_divisor.what: Float, default 5.0. Steam Input haptics: probably a divisor that sets the 'off' part of a pulse relative to the 'on' part (duty cycle).

convar:haptic_tick_gain_modifier.what: Number, default 0. Steam Input haptics: a gain adjustment applied to trackpad 'tick' (detent) haptic pulses.

convar:ibex_mouse_leftside_filter.what: Int, default 32500. Steam Input: like deck_mouse_leftside_filter, but for the 'Ibex' device (a Valve internal codename for a controller). Probably a raw trackpad coordinate threshold used when the trackpad acts as a mouse.

convar:ibex_rumble_deadzone.what: Int, default 635. Steam Input: rumble values below this are ignored on the 'Ibex' device (a Valve internal codename).

convar:installmanagertimeout.what: Int, default 15 (probably seconds). Install manager UI: a timeout used while the install/backup restore manager is working.

convar:ItemsChecked.what: Probably not a real setting: a VGUI ListPanel message name (ItemsChecked with itemid/count) caught by the extractor. There is nothing to set.

convar:KeyCodeTyped.what: Probably not a real setting: the VGUI key event message name (KeyCodeTyped with code/modifiers) caught by the extractor.

convar:lenovo_hook_filter.what: Int, default 31500. Steam Input: probably a raw trackpad/touch coordinate threshold for a Lenovo handheld (e.g. Legion Go) in mouse mode, like deck_mouse_leftside_filter.

convar:library_asset_cache_asset_file_mi.what: Int seconds, default 120. Library artwork cache (libraryassetcache.cpp): asset files younger than this are skipped when the cache is cleaned up.

convar:library_asset_cache_conversion_rt.what: Unix time, default 1724792014 (2024-08-27). Library artwork cache: apps whose cache is older than this need converting to the new cache layout ('App %u requires conversion').

convar:library_asset_cache_full_check_th.what: Int, default 25. Library artwork cache: probably the number of changed apps (or a percentage) above which the whole cache is checked instead of just some apps.

convar:library_asset_cache_full_recheck_.what: Int hours, default 1. Library artwork cache: the minimum time between full rechecks of the asset cache.

convar:library_asset_cache_kvfile_name.what: String, default 'assetcache.vdf'. Library artwork cache: the file name of the cache index (KeyValues file) in the library cache folder.

convar:library_asset_cache_kvfile_versio.what: Int, default 2. Library artwork cache: the format version of the index file. If the version changes, the index is rebuilt.

convar:library_asset_cache_max_notify.what: Int, default 200. Library artwork cache: the maximum number of asset-changed notifications sent to the library UI in one batch.

convar:library_asset_cache_max_requests.what: Int, default 20. Library artwork cache: the maximum number of artwork downloads at once.

convar:library_asset_cache_notify_deboun.what: Int seconds, default 60. Library artwork cache: groups asset-change notifications to the UI so they are sent at most once per this interval.

convar:library_asset_cache_version.what: Int, default 3. Library artwork cache: the version number added to artwork URLs ('cv=%u'), so changing it makes the client fetch fresh images from the CDN.

convar:library_sharing_account_max.what: Int, default 5. Steam Family / Library Sharing: the maximum number of accounts that can share a library on this machine.

convar:@LocalContentServer.what: String. Content downloads: the address of a partner Local Content Server (LCS). It is used for branches marked 'lcsrequired' ('no local content server for beta %s, falling back to public').

convar:log_files_always_flush.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Logging: flushes each line to the log files (logs/<name>.txt) right away. Useful when debugging crashes; slightly slower.

convar:log_matchmaking_callbacks.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Matchmaking: logs lobby and matchmaking callbacks sent to games.

convar:@MatchmakingCreatePingWaitTime.what: Int (probably ms), default 0. Lobby matchmaking: how long lobby creation waits for ping/location data before it continues (LobbyCreated_t).

convar:@MatchmakingJoinPingWaitTime.what: Int (probably ms), default 0. Lobby matchmaking: how long a lobby join waits for ping data before it continues (LobbyEnter_t).

convar:@MatchmakingSearchPingWaitTime.what: Int (probably ms), default 0. Lobby matchmaking: how long a lobby search waits for ping data before it returns results (LobbyMatchList_t).

convar:@MatchmakingTotalPingWaitTime.what: Int (probably ms), default 0. Lobby matchmaking: the total ping-wait budget across create, join and search operations.

convar:@MaxOutstandingSendThreadItemFata.what: Int, default 30000. TCP/SSL send thread: if more items than this are queued for longer than @MaxOutstandingSendThreadItemFatalAssertSecondsAtLimit, the process is killed on purpose ('killing process').
Int seconds, default 30. TCP send thread: how long the queue may stay above the fatal limit before the process is killed.

convar:@MaxOutstandingSendThreadItemSlee.what: Int, default 10000. TCP send thread: when this many items are queued, the sender pauses (back-pressure) before adding more.

convar:MergeCapReprocess_minutes.what: Int minutes, default 480 (8 hours). Probably the minimum time before merged capture/cache data (likely shader cache merges) is processed again.

convar:@metricsDisabledCatalogs.what: Comma-separated list. Metrics: whole metrics catalogs to turn off. This is checked last; @metricsEnabledOperations overrides it.

convar:@metricsDisabledOperations.what: Comma-separated list. Metrics: operations to turn off. This setting takes priority over everything else ('Metrics disabled by operation blacklist').

convar:@metricsEnabledOperations.what: Comma-separated list. Metrics: operations to turn on even if their catalog is disabled ('Metrics enabled by operation whitelist').

convar:mic_autogain.what: Int, default 16000. Voice chat: the target level for automatic gain control on microphone input, probably as a peak sample amplitude.

convar:mic_inputfile.what: File path. Voice chat testing: reads voice data from this WAV file (played in a loop) instead of the microphone.

convar:mic_outputfile.what: File path. Voice chat debugging: writes the microphone data to this file as a RIFF/WAVE file. Close Steam before using the file.

convar:MouseDoublePressed.what: Probably not a real setting: the VGUI mouse event message name (MouseDoublePressed with code/modifiers) caught by the extractor.

convar:MousePressed.what: Probably not a real setting: the VGUI mouse event message name (MousePressed with code/modifiers) caught by the extractor.

convar:musiclogging.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Turns on logging for the client's music player (CClientMusic).

convar:@nBootReserveRetryPeriodSec.what: Int seconds, default 30 (should be a multiple of 10). Disk space: how long to wait before retrying after creating the 'boot reserve' file fails. That file keeps space free so Steam can still start on a nearly full disk.

convar:nBroadcastSessionMaxDropFrames.what: Int, default 100. Steam Broadcasting: probably the maximum number of dropped frames allowed in a session before it is ended or reset.

convar:@nCallerDeadlineHopLatencyMS.what: Int ms, default 10. Job/message system: when a job with a deadline sends a request, the reply timeout is set to the job's remaining time minus this many ms. A negative value stops deadlines being passed on.

convar:nClientBackgroundAutoUpdateLessRe.what: Int hours, default 168 (1 week). Scheduled background updates: games played within this time are updated sooner than games not played for longer. This is the 'less recent' tier.

convar:nClientBackgroundAutoUpdateNotPla.what: Int days, default 14. Scheduled background updates: a game not played for a while is updated on a morning chosen within this many days.

convar:nClientBackgroundAutoUpdateRecent.what: Int hours, default 72. Scheduled background updates: games played within this time are treated as recently played and updated soonest.

convar:nClientBackgroundAutoUpdateTarget.what: Int hour 0-23 (local time), default 6. Scheduled background updates: the target hour for automatic app updates. Updates are spread around it (see nClientBackgroundAutoUpdateTimeSpreadMinutes).

convar:nClientBackgroundAutoUpdateTimeSp.what: Int minutes, default 360. Scheduled background updates: the window around the target hour (a ±2-sigma window, so half on each side) over which updates are randomly spread.

convar:@nClientCloudMaxMBParallelDownloa.what: Int MB, default 64. Steam Cloud sync: the maximum total size of files downloaded at once.

convar:@nClientCloudMaxMBParallelUploads.what: Int MB, default 64. Steam Cloud sync: the maximum total size of files uploaded at once within an upload batch.

convar:@nClientCloudMaxNumParallelDelete.what: Int, default 10. Steam Cloud sync: the maximum number of cloud file deletes or forgets at once.

convar:@nClientCloudMaxNumParallelDownlo.what: Int, default 10. Steam Cloud sync: the maximum number of file downloads at once.

convar:@nClientCloudMaxNumParallelUpload.what: Int, default 10. Steam Cloud sync: the maximum number of file uploads at once.

convar:@nClientCloudMaxNumUploadsPerBatc.what: Int, default 100. Steam Cloud: the maximum number of files in one app upload batch (Cloud.BeginAppUploadBatch). Bigger syncs are split into several batches.

convar:@nClientCMDirectoryResultLoadPerc.what: Int percent, default 10. CM connection: random variation added to the CM server load values from the CMDirectory query, so clients don't all choose the same server.

convar:@nClientCMUDPPingTimeGoodEnoughTh.what: Int ms, default 50. CM connection over UDP: while looking for the best server, a CM that answers within this time is good enough and the search stops.

convar:@nClientCMUDPPingTimeoutUseGoodEn.what: Int ms, default 250. CM connection over UDP: after this long searching for the best server, the client takes a good-enough server instead of waiting for all ping replies.

convar:@nClientDownloadEnableHTTP2RelBra.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. Content downloads: on stable (non-beta) clients, HTTP/2 is used on the enabled platforms only if this is set.

convar:@nClientDownloadInitWindowSizeHTT.what: Int bytes, default 10000000 (~10 MB). Content downloads: the initial HTTP/2 flow-control window for each connection.
Int bytes, default 2000000 (~2 MB). Content downloads: the initial HTTP/2 flow-control window for each stream.

convar:@nClientDownloadProbUseHTTP2IfAva.what: Int percent 0-100, default 50. Content downloads: the chance of using HTTP/2 for a download source that supports it. This is a rollout or A/B setting.

convar:@nClientEnableHTTP2PlatformLinux.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. General client HTTP (the 'App Info' / Steam Engine HTTP client, not depot downloads): allows HTTP/2 on Linux.

convar:@nClientEnableHTTP2PlatformWindow.what: Bool (0/1), default 1. General client HTTP: allows HTTP/2 on Windows clients. Not used on Linux.

convar:@nClientEnableIPv6ForHTTPPlatform.what: Bool (0/1), default 0. General client HTTP (Steam Engine / App Info client): uses IPv6 for HTTP connections by default on Linux.

convar:@nLANPeerRateLimitKbps.what: Int kbps, default 0 (= no limit). LAN peer content transfer: a bandwidth limit for each LAN peer connection.

convar:nProductInfoUpdateInterval.what: Int seconds, default 900 (15 min). Steam engine: how often app and package product info (PICS) is checked for changes.
